overview: One phosphatized Doushantuo specimen preserves a millimetre-scale three-tube body interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy; that affinity remains a single-specimen hypothesis.

ecology.habitat: Marine phosphorite depositional setting; life position unresolved
ecology.guild: Suspension-feeding is a sponge-grade inference, not direct evidence

evidenceSummary: SEM and tomography directly document the holotype geometry, while poriferan affinity is limited by the absence of spicules, a replicated canal system or additional specimens.

overview: Goblet-shaped fossils with nested quadrate grids provide an organic-skeleton body-plan test whose crown-sponge placement is a morphology-matrix result.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the sponge interpretation
ecology.guild: Benthic suspension feeder inferred from morphology

evidenceSummary: The figured holotype and referred material directly preserve the gridded skeleton; material composition, physiology and exact position near Hexactinellida remain interpreted.

overview: BGS GSM 105875 preserves two bifurcating polyp-like tubes with tentacle impressions in a rigid organic skeleton and tests a crown-cnidarian interpretation.

ecology.diet: Prey capture inferred from tentaculate polyps
ecology.habitat: Marine benthic setting inferred from the fossil surface
ecology.guild: Sessile tentaculate feeder inferred from anatomy

evidenceSummary: The specimen and stratigraphic context are direct observations; crown-Cnidaria placement and polyp function are morphology-based interpretations.

overview: The holotype NFM F-994, documented together with plastotype OUM ÁT.424/p, preserves a quadrate Ediacaran impression with repeated aligned structures interpreted as muscular tissue, while later studies dispute the orientation and strength of its staurozoan comparison.

ecology.diet: Not directly preserved; a feeding mode is unresolved
ecology.habitat: Marine Fermeuse Formation setting; life position is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Sessile or attached interpretation; movement was not observed
ecology.guild: Cnidarian affinity and feeding guild remain contested

evidenceSummary: The holotype impression and its locality are directly documented, but tissue identity, orientation and precise cnidarian placement remain contested across the original description, a critical reassessment and a later re-examination.

overview: An expanded Chengjiang sample of 85 new specimens plus type material supports a tentaculate, suspension-feeding reconstruction. Later anatomical work reinterprets the column as tentacle-sheath complexes; its main Bayesian analysis recovers Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem, while sensitivity analyses include a polytomy.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the tentaculate reconstruction
ecology.locomotion: Attached or sessile interpretation; behaviour is not directly observed
ecology.guild: Suspension-feeding guild inferred from reconstructed anatomy

traits: Tentacle-bearing oral crown in the reconstruction

evidenceSummary: Ou et al. directly document the expanded specimen sample and recover a stem-cnidarian hypothesis; Zhao et al. revise the column interpretation and recover Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in the main Bayesian analysis, with a polytomy under alternative coding. Placement remains model-dependent rather than definitively resolved.
